title: Revised Geneva Score for PE
sources: Le Gal G et al. Ann Intern Med 2006; simplified revised Geneva (Klok FA et al. Arch Intern Med 2008)

changelog.change: Initial entry — from ED_ICU_OR_Calculators.xlsx. Standard (non-simplified) point weights.

purpose: Pretest probability of PE using only objective, reproducible variables (no 'PE is the leading diagnosis' gestalt item) — useful when clinician experience varies or for documentation. Drives the D-dimer vs. CT decision.

items.label: Surgery (general anaesthesia) or lower-limb fracture within 1 month
Active malignancy (solid or haematologic, current or cured < 1 year)
Pain on lower-limb deep venous palpation AND unilateral oedema

interpretation.label: Low probability (~ 8% PE prevalence) — proceed to D-dimer (age-adjusted); a negative D-dimer rules out PE
Intermediate probability (~ 29%) — D-dimer; negative rules out, positive → CT pulmonary angiography
High probability (~ 74%) — go straight to CT pulmonary angiography; a negative D-dimer does NOT rule out PE here

notes: Two-tier reading: ≤ 5 = 'PE unlikely' → D-dimer; ≥ 6 = 'PE likely' → imaging. The SIMPLIFIED revised Geneva scores every item 1 point (heart rate 75–94 = 1, ≥ 95 = 2) with a 0–2 / ≥ 3 (or ≤ 1 / ≥ 2) cutoff — validated as equivalent. Pair with PERC / YEARS as appropriate.
buildNote: Standard weights implemented; a simplified toggle is a refinement.
